featured.title: Closer to Heaven
featured.description: A Joyous Reunion - one of Kerri's most beloved works, depicting the heavenly welcome that awaits. Available as a high-quality print.

about.name: Kerri Guthrie
about.bio_1: Kerri Guthrie is an inspired artist and devoted mother. Her passion and vision is evident in her work. Each piece carries a sense of grace, capturing moments that feel both heavenly and deeply personal.
about.bio_2: Based in South Jordan, Utah, Kerri creates original angel-themed artwork that brings comfort, beauty, and a touch of the divine into everyday spaces.
